Why is Krishna blue? As the story goes, when Krishna was a tiny baby in Gokul, a beautiful woman walked into the village. Her name was Putana. She smiled at Yashoda and said, let me feed the baby.

But Putana was a demoness, and her milk was poison. Baby Krishna drank, and drank, and drank, until he drew the life out of her. Her disguise fell away, and the whole village saw the giant she really was.
Wait, did the poison hurt him? Some say that's what turned him blue. But the sages say something deeper. The sky is blue. The ocean is blue. Anything endless looks blue to our eyes.
That's why Krishna is blue. He is as endless as the sky. Comment Shyam if you love his blue.
